Dear [Mrs Greene](../persons.html#583)
It is very prettily described but I am afraid the revulsion of feeling is too painful so I think I had better not accept it.

The Copyright of your stories remains with you, and you are quite welcome to publish them separately[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Greene had contributed a story, \'The Haunted Sacks\' to MP (Christmas 1875) which was reprinted in her God\'s Silver, or, Youthful Days (1877).
